# TMM2063P_10 - 8192 x 8 bit static RAM, N-channel silicon gate MOS, 100 ns

Package DIP-28 (0.3 inch) · family MOS-memory · catalogue file [catalog/chips/TMM2063P_10.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/TMM2063P_10.json)

| 28 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V; +5 V +-10% |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 11-13,15-19 | Read: with CS1 low, CS2 high, OE low and WE high the addressed word is driven on I/O1-I/O8. The outputs are high impedance when CS1 is high, CS2 is low, OE is high or WE is low. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 65536


## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 2.1 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1.0 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Ta 0..70 C, VCC 5 V +-10%: VIH 2.0 V min, VIL 0.8 V max; VOH 2.4 V min at -1.0 mA, VOL 0.4 V max at 2.1 mA; input and output leakage +-10 uA; ICC 80 mA max, standby 10 mA max, peak power-on 20 mA. CIN 5 pF, COUT 10 pF max. Power dissipation 0.8 W max. |

## Not known

- The data book read is the 1987 edition (the sheet carries copyright Aug. 1985); an earlier sheet was not found (the 1983 Toshiba MOS memory book does not list the TMM2063).

## Notes

Card 3207 position 24E; CS2 (pin 26) is tied to +5 V on the card. Only the -10 column is used.

## Sources

- [Toshiba MOS Memory Products data book 1987, TMM2063P-10/-12/-15 8,192 word x 8 bit static RAM](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/toshiba/_dataBook/1987_Toshiba_MOS_Memory.pdf) - pdf 264-269 (printed B-35..B-40); TMM2063P-10
